dedupe_keys.name: ukcs offshore wellbores top holes wgs84

description: The North Sea Transition Authority publishes offshore wellbore top-hole points from its Well Operations Notification System. A well origin is the surface or seabed location where drilling begins or re-enters a well. The schema includes well identifiers, operational and completion status, spud dates, operators and licence references. The source distinguishes top-hole and bottom-hole locations from actual drilled paths. These points do not describe full subsurface trajectories or producing capacity. Coverage is the UK Continental Shelf. Access is through the published ArcGIS feature service. Licence and cost: The item metadata does not state a reuse licence. Caveats: only item, service and layer metadata were inspected. No feature records were downloaded, and current completeness, geometric quality and operational availability remain untested. Access charges are not stated in the inspected metadata. The resource provides mapped infrastructure or service inputs; applying it in a simulation requires checking the source limits and relevant model assumptions. Related NSTA records describe the regularly updated UKCS offshore infrastructure layers.
